title: 道路と橋
theme: roads, bridge and vehicles in a Japanese mountain valley, realistic photographic materials

cells.name: 鉄橋のトラス
cells.prompt: pale green painted steel of a riveted truss bridge member with chipped paint and rust at the rivets, about 1 m across

cells.name: ガードレール
cells.prompt: white painted corrugated W-beam highway guardrail with bolts and road grime, corrugations running left to right, about 2 m across

cells.name: 橋の床版

cells.name: 点字ブロック

cells.name: 縁石

cells.name: 側溝の蓋
cells.prompt: cast iron road gutter grating with long rectangular slots over a dark channel, seen from directly above, slots running top to bottom, about 0.6 m across

cells.name: 赤い車の塗装
cells.prompt: glossy metallic deep red car body paint with soft reflections, about 1 m across

cells.name: 白い車の塗装
cells.prompt: glossy pearl white car body paint with soft reflections and slight road dust, about 1 m across
